datasets.name: BigEarthNet
datasets.summary: Large-scale Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 benchmark for multi-label land-cover classification.
datasets.description: BigEarthNet is a large-scale benchmark archive of Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 image patches annotated with multiple land-cover labels from the CORINE Land Cover map. It was designed to support deep learning for remote sensing image understanding at scale. Version 1.0 provides 590,326 Sentinel-2 patches; the 2024 reBEN (v2.0) release refines the label nomenclature and geographic splits and provides 549,488 patches with paired Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data.

datasets.name: EuroSAT
datasets.summary: Sentinel-2 land-use/land-cover classification benchmark with 10 classes.
datasets.description: EuroSAT is a land-use and land-cover classification dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands. It consists of 27,000 labelled and geo-referenced 64×64 patches across 10 classes. It is distributed in two variants: an RGB-only version and a full 13-band multispectral version.

datasets.name: So2Sat LCZ42
datasets.summary: Sentinel-1/2 benchmark for Local Climate Zone classification over 42 cities.
datasets.description: So2Sat LCZ42 is a benchmark dataset of co-registered Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 image patches over 42 urban agglomerations, hand-labelled into 17 Local Climate Zone (LCZ) classes. It is provided with multiple train/validation/test splits.

datasets.name: RESISC45
datasets.summary: NWPU aerial scene classification benchmark with 45 classes.
datasets.description: RESISC45 (NWPU-RESISC45) is a publicly available benchmark for remote sensing image scene classification, containing 31,500 aerial images of 256×256 pixels across 45 scene classes with 700 images per class.

datasets.name: UC Merced Land Use
datasets.summary: Classic 21-class aerial land-use scene classification dataset.
datasets.description: The UC Merced Land Use dataset is a 21-class land-use image classification dataset of 256×256-pixel aerial images extracted from USGS imagery, with 100 images per class for a total of 2,100 images. It is widely used as a small-scale scene-classification benchmark.

datasets.name: PatternNet
datasets.summary: High-resolution remote sensing image retrieval/classification benchmark, 38 classes.
datasets.description: PatternNet is a large-scale high-resolution remote sensing dataset collected for image retrieval, containing 30,400 images of 256×256 pixels across 38 classes with 800 images per class.

datasets.name: LEVIR-CD
datasets.summary: Large-scale bi-temporal aerial imagery benchmark for building change detection.
datasets.description: LEVIR-CD is a large-scale remote sensing building change detection dataset consisting of 637 pairs of bi-temporal Google Earth images at 0.5 m ground sample distance, each of size 1024×1024 pixels. The dataset contains 31,333 annotated individual change instances and is widely used as a standard benchmark for deep-learning-based change detection methods.

datasets.name: SpaceNet
datasets.summary: Series of satellite-imagery challenges for building footprint and road extraction.
datasets.description: SpaceNet is a corpus of commercial satellite imagery and geospatial data released through a series of open challenges (SpaceNet 1–8) covering tasks such as building footprint extraction, road network detection, off-nadir building detection, and multi-temporal urban change. Imagery sources include WorldView-2, WorldView-3, and Dove satellites at sub-meter to meter resolution across multiple cities worldwide.

datasets.name: Chesapeake Land Cover
datasets.summary: High-resolution aerial land-cover dataset for the Chesapeake Bay watershed.
datasets.description: The Chesapeake Land Cover dataset provides high-resolution (1 m) aerial RGB and near-infrared imagery alongside detailed land-cover labels for the Chesapeake Bay watershed in the eastern United States. It is widely used as a benchmark for semantic segmentation and domain adaptation in remote sensing, covering several US states with consistent annotation across multiple years.

datasets.name: ISPRS Potsdam
datasets.summary: ISPRS urban semantic segmentation benchmark over Potsdam with 6 land-cover classes.
datasets.description: The ISPRS Potsdam dataset is a benchmark for 2D semantic labelling of very high resolution aerial imagery. It provides 38 patches of 6000×6000-pixel true orthophoto tiles with corresponding digital surface models (DSM) and normalized DSMs over the city of Potsdam, Germany, annotated with 6 urban land-cover classes.

datasets.name: ISPRS Vaihingen
datasets.summary: ISPRS urban semantic segmentation benchmark over Vaihingen with 6 land-cover classes.
datasets.description: The ISPRS Vaihingen dataset is a benchmark for 2D semantic labelling of very high resolution airborne imagery. It consists of 33 tiles extracted from a large orthophoto mosaic of the village of Vaihingen, Germany, provided as infrared-red-green (IR-R-G) composites together with a normalized digital surface model (nDSM), annotated with 6 urban land-cover classes.

datasets.name: Tropical Cyclone
datasets.summary: Geostationary satellite imagery dataset for tropical cyclone wind-speed estimation.
datasets.description: The Tropical Cyclone Wind Estimation Competition dataset consists of satellite images of tropical storms from geostationary satellites, paired with corresponding maximum sustained wind-speed labels. It is designed as a regression benchmark for estimating cyclone intensity from single-image satellite observations and is distributed via Radiant MLHub.
